title: Ubangian languages - Wikipedia
text: The Ubangian languages form a diverse linkage of some seventy languages centered on the Central African Republic and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. They are the predominant languages of the CAR, spoken by 2–3 million people, including one of its official languages, Sango.

title: Mbodomo language — Grokipedia
text: Mbodomo, also known as Gbaya-Mbodomo, belongs to the Niger-Congo language phylum, positioned within the Atlantic-Congo branch and the Ubangian group, specifically under the Gbaya macrolanguage.
